people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
translations.bsb: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die, but God will surely visit you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
translations.asv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die; but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
